name: Worlds Craziest Game
desc:
Welcome to the World’s Craziest Game!
This is a modernized version of the classic World’s Hardest Game. We’ve created brand-new stages for you to challenge and earn C$ just by playing. Your progress and data will be saved automatically.

👑 Premium Benefits (Roblox Premium Membership):
Earn 2x coins from purchased productions.
Get 2x coins from gameplay.

🖥️ Supported Platforms: PC, Mobile, Tablet, Console.
The original game was created by Snubby.
